taskbook_inheritance.reason: A strict taskbook-only execution packet must expose that current role-timed tool lookup is inherited without copying the entire catalog or policy into the task body.

TASK_RESEARCH.when: after the exact task semantics and first necessary dependency are understood, before constructing a new general-purpose mechanism or helper calculus, unless the exact taskbook declares an active discovery-information firewall that postpones current-tool visibility until a named freeze point
TASK_RESEARCH.action: query the current toolbox registry, base method inventory, dated method-inventory addenda and executable-source search surface; reuse the narrowest adequate tool or record the exact missing capability

TASK_RESEARCH_DISCOVERY_FIREWALL.action_before_freeze: obey the exact task-local source whitelist/information firewall; do not expose current tool names or catalogs merely to enforce reuse
TASK_RESEARCH_DISCOVERY_FIREWALL.action_after_freeze: run the same registry/base/addenda/executable dedup lookup before claiming method novelty or opening a tool continuation; preserve the frozen result even when it collides with an existing tool
TASK_RESEARCH_DISCOVERY_FIREWALL.scope_rule: this exception exists only when the controlling taskbook explicitly declares a discovery firewall and freeze point; ordinary TASK_RESEARCH cannot self-declare blindness to skip reuse

RESEARCH_DRIVER.when: during intake/routing of a research return and before opening any task whose novelty is a new method/tool/mechanism
RESEARCH_DRIVER.action: deduplicate against existing tool families, base/addendum methods, domain facades and executable modules; route to reuse/composition/extension unless a capability gap is explicit

FOUNDATION_STEWARD.when: before accepting a shared method/tool surface or a Foundation-facing decomposition that appears to introduce reusable machinery
FOUNDATION_STEWARD.action: check all current registry/inventory/executable surfaces and preserve theorem/tool ownership and semantic layer

FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY_PHASE_A.action: computation/formalization may test a question that independently arose from the primitive substrate, but current tool families/method inventories may not choose the first question or candidate

FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY_PHASE_B.when: immediately after the candidate/no-go packet is frozen and before claiming method novelty, uniqueness or a new reusable mechanism
FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY_PHASE_B.action: open the registry, base inventory, dated addenda and executable source for falsification, deduplication, reuse and integration

lookup_layers.rule: All addenda are loaded by tools/enterprise_toolbox.py with duplicate method_id rejection.
AST/docstring/public-function discovery through tools/enterprise_toolbox.py; absence from curated inventories is not evidence that no reusable method exists.

required_questions: Which current tool families were checked?
Which concrete callable methods, dated harvested methods and current executable modules were checked?
Why is reuse or composition insufficient at the required semantic strength?
Is the residue an extension of an existing tool or a genuinely new family?
What exact input/output capability is missing?
new_mechanism_gate.rule: If the gap is only naming, packaging, a special case, or a different application domain, do not create a new tool family. Register an alias, specialization, domain facade or subtool instead.

required_for: route closure with a reusable procedure/certificate/operator
post_return_harvest.required_action: Persist the classification. When routing value changes, update the family registry plus the base inventory or a dated addendum. When production callability is claimed, also add executable source, router discoverability and regression. Otherwise record the exact interface-only/domain/no-tool boundary.

non_promoted_result_requires: method-inventory result/domain/specialization record when future rediscovery risk exists
